ICC PRO · Odoo Integration

Type: REST API with OAuth2 Authentication (Password Grant)

1) Connection Configuration

Type: REST · Base URL: http://your-server:81

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "username": "YOUR_USERNAME",
  "password": "YOUR_PASSWORD",
  "client_id": "YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
  "client_secret": "YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET"
}

Parameters:

  • username: ICC PRO account username (e.g., "MOVAL")
  • password: ICC PRO account password
  • client_id: OAuth2 client identifier (e.g., "Moval-Regadío")
  • client_secret: OAuth2 client secret

2) Authentication Flow

ICC PRO uses OAuth2 Password Grant authentication:

Token Request:

POST /token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=password
&username=YOUR_USERNAME
&password=YOUR_PASSWORD
&client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID
&client_secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET

Token Response:

{
  "access_token": "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJS...",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 86399
}

Using the Token:

All subsequent API calls must include the Authorization header:

Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

3) Available Procedures

  • ICC PRO: Get Mainlines → Login + retrieves all mainlines (devices/meters) from ICC PRO.
  • ICC PRO: Daily Sync → Login + Build Sensor Plan + Get Readings for daily synchronization.
  • ICC PRO: Get Last Readings → Login + Get last reading for each configured meter.

4) API Endpoints

  • POST /token → OAuth2 token endpoint
  • GET /api/mainlines → List all mainlines (devices with meters)
  • GET /api/accumulation/meters → Get meter readings with parameters:
    • utc=true
    • fromdatetime=YYYYMMDDHHmmss
    • todatetime=YYYYMMDDHHmmss
    • resolution=2 (daily)
    • mid={Meter} (meter ID from mainlines)

5) Mainlines Response Structure

[
  {
    "Id": 2536,
    "Name": "3-L051",
    "Description": "01003 MATEO RIQUELM, ROSARIO",
    "FieldUnitId": 17,
    "Meter": 1921,
    "MainValve": 0,
    "MeterType": 5
  },
  ...
]

Key fields:

  • Id: Mainline identifier
  • Name: Mainline name/code
  • Description: Partner/location description
  • Meter: Meter ID (used for readings API)
  • FieldUnitId: Field unit identifier

6) Readings Response Structure

{
  "Data": [
    {
      "Time": "20260101230000",
      "MetersData": [
        {
          "Id": 1272,
          "Volume": 0.0,
          "AccVolume": 5477000.0
        }
      ],
      "VirtualMetersData": []
    },
    ...
  ]
}

Key fields:

  • Time: Timestamp in format YYYYMMDDHHmmss
  • MetersData[].Id: Meter ID
  • MetersData[].Volume: Period volume
  • MetersData[].AccVolume: Accumulated volume (totalizer)

7) Odoo Configuration

In Device (mdm.measurement.device) remotecontrol_params:

{
  "meter_id": 1921,
  "mainline_id": 2536,
  "start_date": "2026-01-01"
}
  • meter_id: Meter ID from ICC PRO (used for readings API)
  • mainline_id: Mainline ID from ICC PRO
  • start_date: Initial date for historical data retrieval

In Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor) remotecontrol_params:

{
  "meter_id": 1921,
  "value_field": "AccVolume"
}
  • meter_id: Meter ID (can be inherited from device)
  • value_field: "AccVolume" for totalizer, "Volume" for period consumption

8) Troubleshooting

  • Connection refused → Check host/port and firewall rules
  • Invalid grant → Verify username/password are correct
  • Invalid client → Verify client_id/client_secret are correct
  • 401 Unauthorized → Token expired, run Get Token again
  • Empty readings → Check meter_id exists and date range is valid
